note: Renders: scratchpad/w15 (m01-m19) and w15q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 3368ba0, compared with w14/w14q (same cameras). Pixel change (max channel diff >12): m16 16.2 %, m03 10.6 %, m10 7.3 %, m09 6.1 %, m01 5.8 %, m07 4.4 %, m12 3.5 %, m17 3.3 %; m11 0 %, q01 0.3 %. The w14 medium items are resolved: the welcome cabinet interior is now neutral smoke and the F/J curtain is cool charcoal. The J lav doors take the fine ash. The remaining items are all low: the latch shape, the ash-flap frames still flat with square-looking corners and a too-bright red, low-contrast insert frames, the bar counter nosing, the dark wood in q01, the jump-seat straps and the bassinet bar. Lighting is noted but not scored: q19 still whites out, and the m01/m09 upper compartments are fogged. Sampling: python3 + PIL mean / p10 / p90 by luminance over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1). Scripts: scratchpad/raterB15/s.py and diff.py. Side-by-side w14|w15 images: scratchpad/raterB15/p_*.png. Contact sheets: sheet0-3.png.

previousIssues.issue: w14b MEDIUM: welcome galley cabinet pane plum-mauve, reads as open purple shelving (m03, m16)
previousIssues.status: fixed for hue; partly fixed for read. m03 pane (520,250,640,300) is now #2b2a2b and (520,330,640,400) #3e3c3d, against w14 #3b3536 / #50484a. omaat_room_32 pane is #22201f upper and #4f4b46 lower. The housing stile (690,250,705,400) is #383530, against the photo stile #333025. In m16 the contents still read crisp with no reflection sheen, so it is glass-free shelving at a glance. Downgraded to low.

previousIssues.issue: w14a MEDIUM / w14b LOW: F/J curtain (curtainF) warm brown (m07)
previousIssues.status: fixed. m07 curtain (560,350,600,520) is #393c47 (w14 #37312d). omaat_room_36 curtain (760,250,850,480) is #302f35. The render is now about 8 levels lighter and a touch bluer (B-R 14 against 5), which is within tolerance.

previousIssues.issue: w14a LOW: welcome cabinet head below the monitor top, tag floating on the fascia, small dark latch (m03, m16)
previousIssues.status: mostly fixed. The head now rises to the monitor top and carries the cream tag and the caution plate, as in omaat_room_32. The latch is silver (#54575c at 470,295,482,320), but it is a tall rounded rectangle with brushed horizontal stripes, so it reads as a vent grille. In the photo it is a horizontal oval (wider than tall) with a vertical thumb-turn, set in a D-shaped boss (photo 718,435,770,455 #665d48).

previousIssues.issue: w14a LOW: bar tumblers read as lidded cans (m05, m06)
previousIssues.status: fixed. The top is now open: rim ring plus a black inner base, and the m05 crop (190,420,345,470) no longer shows a grey lid disc. The bodies are still opaque near-black (#3a3c40), where samchui_render_11 shows clear glass with highlights. Minor.

previousIssues.issue: w14a/b LOW: ash-wall flap frames flat, square corners, single flat red latch (m04)
previousIssues.status: partly fixed. The latch is now two red tabs on a silver plate. The frames are still flat 3 cm strokes with no relief or highlight (125,250,140,450 #bab3a7, std 13.6), and at 930 px the corners still read square (raterB15/corner.png). In lalf_133 the frames have a large radius and a lit top edge, and the clips straddle the frame top in a notch. The red is too saturated: #d72a2c, against photo clips #66201a (dark glossy orange-red).

previousIssues.issue: w14b LOW: galley insert frames low contrast (m09, m01, m12)
previousIssues.status: slightly improved. The m09 frame column (140,10,152,200) has p10 #757470 (w14 #8b8a87) and mean #a5a4a1 (w14 #afaeab), so the rivets and edges read a little more. The frames are still near the face tone, and the pull handles are still flat slots, where sansY_44 has proud bar handles.

previousIssues.issue: w14b LOW: bar counter edge dark slab with separate grey rail, against a bright flush aluminium band (q11, m05, m06)
previousIssues.status: not fixed (m05 counter unchanged; diff 0.07 %, confined to the tumblers).

previousIssues.issue: w14a/b LOW: ash grain coarse on the lav doors, bar doors and ash wall (m17, q11, m04)
previousIssues.status: fixed for the J lav doors: m17 (200,200,300,400) std 3.5 (w14 11.5), mean #c6baa0, fine faint grain. If anything it is now slightly plainer than samchui_render_11's doors (std 10.4). Not fixed on the m04 ash wall, which still shows coarse horizontal bands.

previousIssues.status: not fixed (q01 diff 0.34 %). The q01 walls (50,50,330,500) are #3f3737 with radial streaks at grazing angles. The code tags darkWood as verified from tpa_IMG_0260, so the hue is open; the streak aliasing is the clear defect.
